meta.name: lark-workflow-meeting-summary
meta.description: 会议纪要整理工作流：汇总指定时间范围内的会议纪要并生成结构化报告。当用户需要整理会议纪要、生成会议周报、回顾一段时间内的会议内容时使用。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 汇总指定时间内的会议纪要并生成结构化报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要整理多场会议纪要并形成周报
copy.tagline_en: Summarize meeting notes from a date range into structured reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to compile meeting notes into weekly reports

howto.what: Claude 会按你指定的时间范围（默认过去 7 天）查找会议，汇总每场会议的纪要信息（如纪要链接、逐字稿链接），并整理成单日概览或周报形式的结构化报告；你要求时还可生成云文档。
howto.when: 当你说“帮我整理这周的会议纪要”“总结最近的会议”“生成会议周报”等，或要求回顾某段时间内的会议内容时触发。

say.text: 帮我整理这周的会议纪要并生成周报
say.note: 会搜索本周会议并输出会议纪要周报

say.text: 总结一下过去7天开了哪些会
say.note: 按默认时间范围汇总会议并给出概览

say.text: 把上周的会议纪要汇总成一个文档
say.note: 会生成一份会议纪要汇总的云文档

howto.what_en: Claude will find meetings within a specified time range (default: past 7 days), gather summary info (e.g., notes and transcript links) for each meeting, and produce a structured report (single-day overview or weekly report). Optionally, it can create a cloud document when asked.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to organize meeting notes, generate a weekly meeting report, or review meetings over a period, e.g. “summarize this week's meetings” or “review last week's meetings”.

say_en.text: Summarize this week's meetings into a weekly report.
say_en.note: Searches this week's meetings and outputs a weekly summary.

say_en.text: Give me an overview of meetings from the past 7 days.
say_en.note: Uses the default time range and lists meetings.

say_en.text: Create a document summarizing last week's meetings.
say_en.note: Generates a cloud document with the meeting summary.
